entities.name: Bartek
entities.description: Young crate loader on Ravnica who fell into a setup by the Bane Alley broker Andra.

entities.name: Andra
entities.description: Bane Alley broker and Dimir agent who staged Bartek's mugging.

entities.name: Imrich
entities.description: Stall vendor at Tin Street Market who sold Bartek a necklace.

entities.name: Nico
entities.description: Thug who warned Bartek about the shop-girl.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild Andra works for as an agent.

events.summary: Bartek buys a pewter necklace from Imrich.
events.quote: encountered the stall vendor Imrich who offered him a pewter necklace

events.summary: Nico warns Bartek that the shop-girl only wants his money; Bartek tells him off.
events.quote: warned him that the girl he was going to give it to was a shop-girl

events.summary: Bartek gives Andra the necklace and she accepts.
events.quote: Bartek offered her the pewter necklace as a gift, and after some banter, she accepted it.

events.summary: Andra sells Bartek a dagger for five zinos.
events.quote: Andra then offered to sell Bartek a dagger for five zinos.

events.summary: Bartek is mugged and loses the dagger; Andra offers the money back but he refuses.
events.quote: Two thugs grabbed him, knocked him over his head, and stole his dagger.

events.summary: Andra is revealed to have staged the mugging and to be a Dimir agent.
events.quote: Andra herself had staged the mugging, and that she was a Dimir agent

relations.quote: Andra herself had staged the mugging, and that she was a Dimir agent
